title: Bread Uthappam !!  Instant snack for Breakfast/Tea time  !
description: this video shows how to make a tasty and simple breakfast . The vegetables and semolina/sooji  add to the taste and make it a perfect breakfast recipe . Served with tomato sauce or Mint chutney it is liked by all. Ingredients Bread  10 slices Rava/sooji/Semolina  1 cup Curd  1 cup Onions 2 chopped Tomato 1 Green chilies 2 Curry leaves a few coriander leaves  a few  Capsicum 1 small salt to taste  Oil 3-4 Tbsp  #VegBreakfast#Bread Recipes#Gita'sKitchen

asr.full_text: Namaste, Welcome to Kitas Kitchen. Today I will show you how to make a very interesting breakfast or snack recipe that is, bread otappam So for that we require This semolina or wheat rava or sooji I am taking 1 cup of that. To this add, 1 cup of curd. Mix the two together and keep it aside for about 10 minutes. Now heat a spoon of oil in a pan. Now add a few cumin seeds, about 1 1 of teaspoon of cumin seeds 1.5 tsp cumin seeds Next, I have here 2 onions that I have finely chopped 1 tomato 1 capsicum 1 or 2 green chillies as per taste Some coriander and curry leaves We will add all these together one by one into this. First sauté the onions a little bit. Add red chilli flakes. Just stir fry them together lightly for 2 to 3 minutes. They will not be cooked very well. But you can just lightly stir fry them. Add a little bit of salt. Add 1 tbsp water, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp turmeric powder and mix. Add water now and cook it for about 30 minutes. Add salt. then we can wait till sooji is soaked and rava cools down a little bit. See, it is 10 minutes now the rava has soaked well. I think i will just add a little more of curd to this because it has become too dry. This depends on the quality of you suji or rava, sometimes it absorbs liquid more sometimes it takes less liquid. That's why I only added half cup at the beginning.If required, I added one more tbsp. Now these vegetables which we have stir fried and kept, just add it to this rava and curd Add all the vegetables to the mixed rice mixture. Add salt to it. Adding little bit more salt for curds and rava. Mix them all together very well. We got a good mix of all the ingredients. Add onion,sauce you like add salt and curry leaves. Now I am making a small ball from the mixture in a round shape and spreading it on one side of the bread slice. Place this facedown first. Now you can cook the this with butter or ghee or just your any cooking oil you in the main course. Then cook it. It will cook more in the main course. And cook on the other side also. When the other side is also done, just carefully take it out on a plate like this. There. Your bread woodappam is ready to serve. This is one cup of bread. You adjust the quantity accordingly. If you don't make it runny, it might not spread on the bread. Add 1 cup of rice while it is cooking. Make sure you have a lot of oil. Add onions. Add sliced green chillies and green chillies. Add chopped onions & mix it well. In another pan. Add coconut milk if you want to make it more. Add a pinch of salt. Add fried onions. Once cooked give a stir and cook till brown. When both sides are and press it through a ladle to let it cool down. Something slightly different, but in a very normal way, for an early breakfast. This tasty bread uttapams can be served for breakfast too. add the green chillies adults will also enjoy the spicy crunch in it. I have added few tomato sauce and green chutney to go with it. It's really good, so a different type of bread recipe for a change. Please subscribe Geethas kitchen and we will meet again in the next interesting recipe video Thank you
